cards.name: Torkoal
cards.description: It burns coal inside its shell for energy. It blows out black soot if it is endangered.

cards.name: Turtwig
cards.description: The shell on its back is made of soil. On a very healthy TURTWIG, the shell should feel moist.

cards.name: Vulpix
cards.description: It controls balls of fire. As it grows, its six tails split from their tips to make more tails.

cards.name: Wurmple
cards.description: Often targeted by bird Pokémon, it desperately resists by releasing poison from its tail spikes.

cards.name: Team Galactic's Invention G-101 Energy Gain
Team Galactic's Invention G-103 Power Spray
Team Galactic's Invention G-105 Poké Turn
Electabuzz
cards.description: It loves to feed on strong electricity. It occasionally appears around large power plants and so on.

cards.name: Hitmonchan
cards.description: The spirit of a pro boxer has infused this POKéMON. It throws punches that are faster than a bullet train.

cards.name: Scyther
cards.description: It tears and shreds prey with its wickedly sharp scythes. It very rarely spreads its wings to fly.

cards.name: Shaymin
cards.description: It lives in flower patches and avoids detection by curling up to look like a flowering plant.

cards.name: Shaymin
cards.description: The flowers all over its body burst into bloom if it is lovingly hugged and senses gratitude.

cards.name: Slaking
cards.description: The world's laziest Pokémon. When it is lounging, it is actually saving energy for striking back.

cards.name: Beautifly
cards.description: Despite its looks, it is aggressive. It jabs with its long, thin mouth if disturbed while collecting pollen.

cards.name: Dialga
cards.description: A legendary Pokémon of Sinnoh. It is said that time flows when Dialga's heart beats.

cards.name: Empoleon
cards.description: If anyone were to hurt its pride, it would slash them with wings that can cleave through an ice floe.

cards.name: Giratina
cards.description: A Pokémon that is said to live in a world on the reverse side of ours. It appears in an ancient cemetery.

cards.name: Giratina
cards.description: It was banished for its violence. It silently gazed upon the old world from the Distortion World.

cards.name: Golduck
cards.description: It is seen swimming dynamically and elegantly using its well-developed limbs and flippers.

cards.name: Infernape
cards.description: It uses unique fighting moves with fires on its hands and feet. It will take on any opponent.

cards.name: Kricketune
cards.description: There is a village that hosts a contest based on the amazingly variable cries of this Pokémon.

cards.name: Lickilicky
cards.description: The long tongue is always soggy with slobber. The saliva contains a solvent that causes numbness.

cards.name: Luvdisc
cards.description: It lives in warm seas. It is said that a couple finding this Pokémon will be blessed with eternal love.

cards.name: Ninetales
cards.description: Its nine tails are said to be imbued with a mystic power. It can live for a thousand years.

cards.name: Palkia
cards.description: A legendary Pokémon of Sinnoh. It is said that space becomes more stable with PALKIA's every breath.

cards.name: Shaymin
cards.description: It lives in flower patches and avoids detection by curling up to look like a flowering plant.

cards.name: Torterra
cards.description: Some Pokémon are born on a TORTERRA's back and spend their entire life there.

cards.name: Cacturne
cards.description: It becomes active at night, seeking prey that is exhausted from the day's desert heat.

cards.name: Cascoon
cards.description: It never forgets any attack it endured while in the cocoon. After evolution, it seeks payback.

cards.name: Combusken
cards.description: Its kicking mastery lets it loose 10 kicks per second. It emits sharp cries to intimidate foes.

cards.name: Cranidos
cards.description: A lifelong jungle dweller from 100 million years ago, it would snap obstructing trees with head butts.

cards.name: Flaaffy
cards.description: If its coat becomes fully charged with electricity, its tail lights up. It fires hair that zaps on impact.

cards.name: Grotle
cards.description: It knows where pure water wells up. It carries fellow Pokémon there on its back.

cards.name: Dialga
cards.description: It has the power to control time. It appears in Sinnoh-region myths as an ancient deity.

cards.name: Kirlia
cards.description: If its Trainer becomes happy, it overflows with energy, dancing joyously while spinning about.

cards.name: Lombre
cards.description: It has a mischievous spirit. If it spots an angler, it will tug on the fishing line to interfere.

cards.name: Lucario
cards.description: A well-trained one can sense auras to identify and take in the feelings of creatures over half a mile away.

cards.name: Mismagius
cards.description: Its cry sounds like an incantation. It is said the cry may rarely be imbued with happiness-giving power.

cards.name: Monferno
cards.description: It skillfully control the intensity of the fire on its tail to keep its foes at an ideal distance.

cards.name: Octillery
cards.description: It loves to lurk inside holes in rocks. It sometimes sprays ink on prey by sticking out only its mouth.

cards.name: Prinplup
cards.description: Because every PRINPLUP considers itself to be the most important, they can never form a group.

cards.name: Dialga
cards.description: It has the power to control time. It appears in Sinnoh-region myths as an ancient deity.

cards.name: Probopass
cards.description: It freely controls three small units called Mini-Noses using magnetic force.

cards.name: Shieldon
cards.description: It is outstandingly armored. As a result, it can eat grass and berries without having to fight.

cards.name: Silcoon
cards.description: It wraps silk around the branches of a tree. It drinks rainwater on its silk while awaiting evolution.

cards.name: Vigoroth
cards.description: Its heart beats at a tenfold tempo, so it cannot sit still even for a moment.

cards.name: Wartortle
cards.description: It is said to live 10,000 years. Its furry tail is popular as a symbol of longevity.

cards.name: Cacnea
cards.description: By storing water in its body, this desert dweller can survive 30 days without water.

cards.name: Carnivine
cards.description: It binds itself to trees in marshes. It attracts prey with its sweet-smelling drool and gulps them down.

cards.name: Chansey
cards.description: A kindly Pokémon that lays highly nutritious eggs and shares them with injured Pokémon or people.

cards.name: Chimchar
cards.description: It is very agile. Before going to sleep, it extinguishes the flame on its tail to prevent fires.

cards.name: Combee
cards.description: The trio is together from birth. It constantly gathers honey from flowers to please VESPIQUEN.

cards.name: Diglett
cards.description: A Pokémon that lives underground. Because of its dark habitat, it is repelled by bright sunlight.

cards.name: Dunsparce
cards.description: It digs into the ground with its tail and makes a mazelike nest. It can fly just a little.

cards.name: Electrike
cards.description: Using electricity stored in its fur, it stimulates its muscles to heighten its reaction speed.

cards.name: Grimer
cards.description: It was born when sludge in a dirty stream was exposed to the moon's X-rays. It appears among filth.

cards.name: Happiny
cards.description: It likes to carry around a small rock. It may wander around others' feet and cause them to stumble.

cards.name: Kricketot
cards.description: Its legs are short. Whenever it stumbles, its stiff antennae clack with a xylophone-like sound.

cards.name: Lapras
cards.description: It loves crossing the sea with people and Pokémon on its back. It understands human speech.

cards.name: Lickitung
cards.description: When it extends its over-six-foot-long tongue, its tail quivers. There is a possibility they are connected.

cards.name: Lotad
cards.description: It looks like an aquatic plant and serves as a ferry to Pokémon that can't swim.

cards.name: Mareep
cards.description: Its fluffy coat swells to double when static electricity builds up. Touching it can be shocking.

cards.name: Misdreavus
cards.description: A Pokémon that startles people in the middle of the night. It gathers fear as its energy.

cards.name: Nosepass
cards.description: When endangered, it may protect itself by raising its magnetism and drawing iron objects to its body.

cards.name: Piplup
cards.description: A poor walker, it often falls down. However, its strong pride makes it puff up its chest without a care.

cards.name: Poochyena
cards.description: A Pokémon with persistent nature, it chases its prey until the prey becomes exhausted.

cards.name: Psyduck
cards.description: Overwhelmed by enigmatic abilities, it suffers a constant headache. It sometimes uses mysterious powers.

cards.name: Ralts
cards.description: If its horns capture the warm feelings of people or Pokémon, its body warms up slightly.

cards.name: Remoraid
cards.description: It forcefully squirts water. The water jet never misses prey even if the REMORAID is deep in the sea.

cards.name: Riolu
cards.description: It has the peculiar power of being able to see emotions such as joy and rage in the form of waves.

cards.name: Shuppet
cards.description: It loves vengeful emotions and hangs in rows under the eaves of houses where vengeful people live.

cards.name: Skitty
cards.description: It can't stop itself from chasing moving things, and it runs in a circle, chasing its own tail.

cards.name: Slakoth
cards.description: It spends nearly all its time in a day sprawled out. Just seeing it makes one drowsy.

cards.name: Squirtle
cards.description: It shelters itself in its shell, then strikes back with spouts of water at every opportunity.

cards.name: Swablu
cards.description: It can't relax if it or its surroundings are not clean. It wipes off dirt with its wings.

cards.name: Tauros
cards.description: Once it takes aim at its foe, it makes a headlong charge. It is famous for its violent nature.

cards.name: Torchic
cards.description: A fire burns inside, so it feels very warm to hug. It launches fireballs of 1,800 degrees F.
